candidate_selection.ordinary_and_historical_control_outputs: unchanged except cache revision identity and timing

future_e2e_gate: Held-out real repository families, chronological replay, identical model/tool budget, hidden tests, time to correct patch and cost per successful task; not executed in this iteration
